payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Full-suite comparison for bob-cli-ft.3.1 lander. npm test on the phase tree failed 8 tests; npm test on clean base 89dae58a7d136e4a9a1bb79156212ecd926e706a failed 6, so the full-suite failures are not identical. Five names matched: the reload event fires only when the due key set changes (bob-cli-et); forced check feedback follows the bob refresh result (bob-cli-f7); the startup storm is linear and relationIndex registers after layout-ready and never reads non-markdown during startup replay (bob-cli-eh); future scheduling on Pending marks Blocked but still writes the Work Log (bob-cli-ff). The phase full run also failed three thresholds in unchanged scripts/test-block-id-prompt-task-wikilink-index-performance.cjs: cold build chunk 16.3 ms > 16 ms, warm snapshot plus order 157.3 ms > 50 ms, and keystroke rank 28.4 ms > 12 ms. Isolated node --test scripts/test-block-id-prompt-task-wikilink-index-performance.cjs failed warm snapshot plus order and keystroke rank on both phase (113.4 ms; 14.7 ms) and clean base (70.9 ms; 15.3 ms), matching the tracked bob-cli-f8 issue; cold build passed isolated on both and remains intermittent. The clean-base full run alone failed production CSS reduced-motion; the focused phase CSS test passed 2/2. The new Live Preview editor test passed 9/9. Land agent should evaluate these nonidentical full-suite results with the cited existing tasks, rather than treating all eight phase failures as clean-base matches.

Verified Live Preview editor tests (9/9) and reduced-motion CSS tests (2/2); compared npm test against clean base 89dae58a7d136e4a9a1bb79156212ecd926e706a and recorded nonidentical failures in the proposed follow-up note.
